profile.name: Mahdi Shabani
profile.tagline: Projects, research, and articles on explainable AI, uncertainty-aware machine learning, and spatial data science.
profile.shortBio: Machine Learning researcher focused on spatial data science, explainable AI, uncertainty quantification, and computer vision for mineral exploration.

brand.positioning: AI-driven spatial intelligence for mineral exploration and geoscience.
brand.valueProposition: Turning complex spatial and exploration data into explainable, reliable, and actionable intelligence.

projects.title: AIM Core Log
projects.subtitle: AI-Powered Drill Core Classification
projects.description: An AI-powered computer vision system designed to automate lithology classification from drill core photographs for mineral exploration. The system uses a PyTorch-based training pipeline with transfer learning and an active-learning feedback loop that incorporates geologist corrections to continuously improve model performance.
projects.impact: Reducing manual core-logging workload while creating a scalable and continuously improving geological classification workflow.

projects.title: KanYab
projects.subtitle: AI-Powered Geochemical Exploration Analytics
projects.description: An AI-powered analytics system for mineral exploration that identifies anomalous geochemical samples, discovers meaningful element relationships, and highlights pathfinder signatures associated with mineralization.
projects.impact: Helping exploration teams transform large geochemical datasets into interpretable evidence for prioritizing exploration targets.

research.title: Development of an Explainable and Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning Framework for Spatial Decision-Making
research.domain: Explainable AI · Uncertainty Quantification · Spatial Decision-Making
research.description: A research framework that integrates explainable artificial intelligence and uncertainty quantification into spatial machine learning workflows. The goal is to improve transparency, reliability, and decision confidence when machine learning models are applied to complex spatial problems.

careerDirection.current: Machine Learning · Spatial Data Science · Mineral Exploration
careerDirection.longTerm: Building intelligent AI systems for mineral exploration, spatial decision-making, and digital mining.

profile.name: مهدی شعبانی

projects.title: AIM Core Log
projects.subtitle: طبقه‌بندی مغزهٔ حفاری با هوش مصنوعی
projects.description: سامانه‌ای مبتنی بر بینایی ماشین برای خودکارسازی طبقه‌بندی سنگ‌شناسی از تصاویر مغزه‌های حفاری در اکتشاف معدن. این سامانه از خط لولهٔ آموزشی مبتنی بر PyTorch، یادگیری انتقالی و چرخهٔ یادگیری فعال استفاده می‌کند تا اصلاحات کارشناسان زمین‌شناسی را وارد کرده و عملکرد مدل را به‌طور مستمر بهبود دهد.
projects.impact: کاهش زمان موردنیاز برای ثبت دستی مغزه و ایجاد یک فرایند مقیاس‌پذیر و پیوسته‌بهبود‌یابنده برای طبقه‌بندی زمین‌شناسی.

projects.impact: کمک به تیم‌های اکتشافی برای تبدیل مجموعه‌داده‌های بزرگ ژئوشیمیایی به شواهد قابل‌تفسیر جهت اولویت‌بندی اهداف اکتشافی.
